display.title: {"text": "Ocean Expeditions"}
description: Shipwrecks, sunken ruins, monuments, pirate ships, galleys and the Sunken City. Breath and visibility are the real enemy.
&ePrepare:&r Respiration/Aqua Affinity, night vision, a boat, doors or conduit for air. Monuments: Mining Fatigue cure (milk).
&eSignature rewards:&r Tidebound Doubloons (exchange for Lunar/Slipstream gems), buried-treasure cores, Heart of the Sea.
&eComing back:&r Oceans are vast and cheap to cross by boat; many small wrecks keep doubloon income steady.
&eFeeds into:&r Doubloons -> targeted gems; cores -> sockets; monument prismarine for building.
&eBrings home:&r The Drowned Coast expedition (Expedition Hall). Tidebound Doubloons are its contribution; Tide Charts point here.
&aDo:&r Walk into any ocean expeditions structure (early-late game).
&6You get:&r Tidebound Doubloons (exchange for Lunar/Slipstream gems), buried-treasure cores, Heart of the Sea.
